selectors.predicate: Every listed package or protocol surface has route, import, restoration, and absence proof at one head/tree.
Every listed shipping product surface has an accepted receipt and exact state registration; aggregate cards are excluded from their own input.
Every listed brand/HIG/accessibility/localization consumer is accepted at the exact candidate.
Every public capability claim maps to accepted evidence or a typed disabled/absent state.
Exactly 132 pre-P05 autonomous receipts; P05-C01 is excluded from the set it consumes.
No operational Party/contact/signoff identity converts into marketing, measurement, rating, or subscriber identity.

Every listed P01–P03 implementation card enumerates every owned kind as persistent, portable, or NONPERSISTENT; every persistent/portable kind has matching lifecycle, codec, hostile, interruption, recovery, compatibility, and Release-exclusion receipts.
